definitions.full: H6115. otser עֹ֫צֶר noun [masculine] restraint, coercion ; — ׳ע absolute: ׳מֵע וּמִמִּשְׁפָט Isa 53:8 from (as a result of) coercion and judgment he was taken off; construct ׳ע רָעָה Psa 107:39 ; ׳ע רָ֑חַם Prov 30:16 restraint of womb , barrenness (so Psa 107:39 Perles Anal. 85 ).
